events.verdict: Beasley (DET) engages with Monk (SAC) as he moves to set the pick.
Ivey (DET) legally contests Fox's (SAC) jump shot, making incidental "high-five" contact following his release.
Harris (DET) places his hand against DeRozan's (SAC) side and does not apply force contesting his shot attempt.
Beasley (DET) establishes himself in Murray's (SAC) path and absorbs the marginal contact during the pick.
Murray (SAC) contests Beasley's (DET) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Beasley (DET) places his forearm against Monk's (SAC) front during his drive to the basket and the contact is marginal.
Lyles (SAC) pursues the rebound and the contact with Duren's (DET) arm is marginal.
Fox (SAC) saves the ball and throws it off of Duren (DET), who is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
Fox (SAC) momentarily places his hand against Ivey's (DET) side and removes it without applying force as he steps back.
Fox (SAC) reaches in and grazes Ivey's (DET) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Cunningham (DET) commits a take foul on Lyles (SAC).
Beasley (DET) commits a take foul on Huerter (SAC).
Huerter (SAC) briefly places his hands around Beasley's (DET) waist prior to correcting.

Fox (SAC) initiates illegal contact that affects Ivey's (DET) jump shot attempt and Ivey does not overtly or abruptly jump to the side to create the contact. Continuation is awarded because the illegal contact occurs after the start of Ivey's upward shooting motion.
